name: ViiNeuS
definition: A hybrid implicit surface learning method that efficiently initializes the signed distance field (SDF) to reconstruct large driving scenes from 2D street view images with limited overlap, without relying on geometric priors or LiDAR.
summary: ViiNeuS initializes urban scene reconstruction from limited images by modeling density and signed distance in separate fields, transitioning from volumetric to surface representation without geometric priors.
